name: Lucky Strike Bar & Lounge at Port Jeff Bowl

evidence.note: Venue page lists Terror Garden on Oct 3 (music starts 7:30 PM) and says line dancing every Monday.
Long Island country music group lists Monday line dancing at the Lucky Strike Lounge: lesson 6-6:30 PM, open dancing 6:30-9 PM.
Teacher's listing for a Monday open dance night at the lounge; all levels welcome, $15.

dancing.notes: The lounge holds a line dance night every Monday with a short lesson, then open dancing with requests. On Saturday band nights the music is live rock, but we found no reports on how much people dance then.

description: The bar and lounge inside the Port Jeff Bowl bowling center. It has live cover bands most Saturdays and a weekly line dancing night.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Not the Lucky Strike bowling chain location in Sayville. Size of the dance area not confirmed. Monday line dancing is run by an outside teacher ('Dancing in Line with Helen').

Directory research 2026-10-04: The site's schedule confirms bands on most Saturdays (plus a few Fridays and the night before Thanksgiving) and line dancing every Monday, so the current description still fits; some shows have a $10 cover. Hours listed are for the whole Port Jeff Bowl center; the lounge's own hours are not published separately. Logo is the Port Jeff Bowl logo (the lounge has no separate logo file on the site, only its sign). Email and phone are Port Jeff Bowl's. Port Jeff Bowl also has its own pages (facebook.com/portjeffbowl, instagram.com/portjeffbowl). Google Maps calls it 'Lucky Strike Bar & Grill @ Port Jeff Bowl'. Not the Lucky Strike bowling chain. Photo files were served as WebP by the site's image CDN.
hours: Port Jeff Bowl hours: Mon-Tue 12-11 PM; Wed 11 AM-11 PM; Thu 10 AM-11 PM; Fri 12 PM-12 AM; Sat 10 AM-12 AM; Sun 9 AM-10:30 PM
